_comment: Settings for the Retell demo agent. `npm run agent` pushes this file plus demo-prompt.md to Retell. Prices, trial and contact numbers come from site.config.json. The Worker also reads textTheCaller and ringOnEmergency, so after changing either run `npm run deploy` and then `npm run agent`.
beginMessage: Hey, this is the Yello 412 demo line. Heads up, this call is recorded. Tell me your business name and I'll answer as your line, or just say skip.
